gaps_in_existing_data_flow: Stage graph is declarative artifact matching, not a call graph.
Plan renders per-point scripts in memory; ordinary plan writes plan.json, not solver script files.
Run resolves inputs and preflights again; it builds its own grouped sweep script.
CLI entry, plan receipt/digest gate, executor selection and workflow emission are absent.
Local collection and automatic post during run are explained in prose but not separate nodes in the SVG.
Submission, settling checks, per-point assessment, file moves, runs.json transitions and shared definitions are absent.
Provenance fields/hashes, concrete paths, current pproc inputs and product admission/refusal branches are absent.
